wallet.confirmReplaceMsg: Detected existing wallet information ({{desc}}). Creating/Recovering a wallet will replace the existing information. Please ensure you have backed up your current mnemonic/private key.
wallet.confirmReplaceReadOnlyMsg: The current address is read-only ({{desc}}). Continuing will replace it with a full-function wallet. You do not need to delete it first.
wallet.confirmReplaceToReadOnlyMsg: The current wallet is full-function ({{desc}}). Switching to a query-only address will disable sending in this app. Please confirm you have backed up the mnemonic or private key.
wallet.currentReadOnlyHint: This is a query-only address. You can upgrade it with the three methods below without deleting first.
wallet.currentWriteHint: A full-function wallet already exists. Using another method will replace it. Back up the mnemonic or private key first.
wallet.optionAddAddressHint: Address only. Query data, cannot send.
wallet.optionCreateHint: Create a local wallet that can send data
wallet.optionMnemonicHint: Restore an existing wallet with a mnemonic
wallet.optionPrivateKeyHint: Restore an existing wallet with a private key
wallet.mnemonicSubtitle: Please copy the following 24 words accurately on paper and keep them in a safe place.
wallet.mnemonicWarning: WARNING: Never reveal your mnemonic to anyone! Once lost, assets cannot be recovered.
wallet.mnemonicCheckbox: I have properly backed up the mnemonic and confirm its importance.
wallet.inputMnemonicSubtitle: Please enter your mnemonic words, separated by spaces.
wallet.inputMnemonicTip: Tip: Mnemonic is entered separated by spaces.
wallet.inputMnemonicInvalid: Some words may not be valid wallet words, please check spelling.
wallet.inputMnemonicCountInvalid: Mnemonic count is incorrect (currently {{count}}), usually 12 or 24 words.
wallet.inputMnemonicCheck: Note: Please check each word carefully.
wallet.verifySubtitle: The following is the wallet address identified based on your input. Please confirm if it is correct.
wallet.verifyTip: If the address is incorrect, please go back and check the input.
wallet.setupHint: The payment password is used to locally encrypt your private key data. Please remember it well.
wallet.setupNoExportHint: After wallet creation, this app does not support exporting or viewing your private key or mnemonic. Please ensure you have backed up your mnemonic.
wallet.createDisclaimer1: The mnemonic is the only credential for recovering your wallet. If I lose my mnemonic, I will not be able to recover my assets.
wallet.createDisclaimer2: Anyone who obtains my mnemonic can fully control and transfer my assets.
wallet.createDisclaimer3: This app does not store my mnemonic or private key on any server. They are only encrypted with my payment password and stored locally on my device.
wallet.createDisclaimer4: If I uninstall the app without backing up my mnemonic, my wallet data will be permanently lost.
wallet.createDisclaimer5: This app does not support exporting or viewing your private key or mnemonic after wallet creation. You must back up your mnemonic in the next step — this is your only chance.
wallet.createDisclaimerCheckbox: I have read and acknowledged the above statements and consequences, and agree to proceed with wallet creation.
wallet.mnemonicNoExportWarning: IMPORTANT: The mnemonic is shown only once here. After wallet creation, this app does not support viewing or exporting your mnemonic or private key again.
wallet.setupFailed: Wallet setup failed, please try again.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimer1: The private key is the highest authority credential for controlling your wallet assets. Please ensure recovery in a completely safe and private environment.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimer2: Once the private key is leaked, anyone can instantly transfer your assets. Displaying or entering the private key in any public place is strictly prohibited.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimer3: Recovery will replace the current locally associated wallet information.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimer4: This app does not store or upload your private key to any server. The private key is only stored in the device's secure chip after encryption with your payment password.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimer5: If you lose your private key and have not properly backed it up, the app cannot recover the wallet for you.
wallet.privateKeyDisclaimerCheckbox: I have read and acknowledged the above risks and consequences and agree to proceed with the recovery.
wallet.privateKeyInputSubtitle: Please enter your wallet private key below.
wallet.privateKeyInputWarning: WARNING: Do not disclose your private key to anyone. Ensure a safe environment, do not operate on public devices or public networks.
wallet.privateKeyInputInvalid: Invalid private key, please check your input. Private keys are usually 64 hexadecimal characters.
wallet.recoverDisclaimer1: The mnemonic is the only credential for recovering the wallet. Please ensure recovery in a safe and private environment.
wallet.recoverDisclaimer2: Recovery will replace the current locally associated wallet address.
wallet.recoverDisclaimer3: Please ensure the mnemonic entered is completely correct. Incorrect mnemonic will result in recovery of the wrong address or failure.
wallet.recoverDisclaimer4: This app does not upload or store your mnemonic on any server. All decryption and recovery operations are completed in a local secure environment.
wallet.recoverDisclaimerCheckbox: I have read and acknowledged the above statement and consequences and agree to proceed with the recovery.

send.networkFaultMsg: Multiple send attempts failed. This may be a network issue. Check your connection and try again later.
send.confirmCancelMsg: Are you sure you want to cancel? This will clear the entered data.
